name: V7 Product Alternatives
author: Vaibhaw Kumar

sections.description:
V7 Product Alternatives transforms out-of-stock product pages into conversion bridges by suggesting curated alternatives.

Features

  • Native WooCommerce integration
  • Automatic display based on stock status
  • Variable product support
  • Brand display from multiple sources
  • Fully customizable via settings page
  • Custom text, colors, and styles
  • Fully responsive design
  • Translation ready (i18n)
  • GDPR compliant

Settings

Customize everything from WooCommerce > Product Alternatives:

  • Title text
  • Button text
  • Accent color
  • Text color
  • Background color
  • Border radius
  • Show/hide brand
  • Show/hide price
sections.installation:
1. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/v7-product-alternatives/
  2. Activate via Plugins menu
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is active
  4. Configure via WooCommerce > Product Alternatives
  5. Edit products and set Alternative Product field
sections.faq:
Does this require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and active.

How do I customize the appearance?

Go to WooCommerce > Product Alternatives to customize text, colors, and styles.

Is it translation ready?

Yes, all strings are translatable. Use the included POT file.
